html:
Quest Giver: Tilles the Sellout

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 2 of Rotgut's Unusual Stuffed Hoot Owl Relics from within the The Mutanous Malaise and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Quest Reward: 10 King's Coins

Return to: Tilles the Sellout

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Mutanous Malaise

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect 2 of Rotgut's Unusual Stuffed Hoot Owl Relics from within the The Mutanous Malaise and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Offer:

Relic Exchange of Townston: Specializing in Vendor Trash since Version 0.59!
WANTED: 2 of Rotgut's Unusual Stuffed Hoot Owl Relics. Willing to pay King's Coin for Relics at a great rate! Contact Tilles the Sellout for more info.

Turn-in:

You have a knack for finding these Relics. I'll contact the person who posted the ad on your behalf.

Objectives:

  • Rotgut's Unusual Relics ×2

Client level range: 30–55
